name: Jackson Sly
source:
Jackson Sly always knew that he wanted to be a teacher... Or a movie star. Unfortunately, the commute from North Idaho to Hollywood was a rather long drive, so he set his sights early to get a career in education.

Jackson and Isabel became best friends at a young age. He called her Isa, and she called him Jay. They were practically glued at the hip since the moment they met each other.

Jackson would eventually realize that he had feelings for Isabel, but he would never admit it because he was afraid of ruining the friendship that they had.

Jackson lost his sight in his right eye when he was in high school. It was from a prank gone very wrong. However, Jackson decided to keep the details of what happened to himself, and the person never got in trouble for their actions.

Jackson is half Vietnamese.

[Taken from Make It Last: While You Can's Codex Entry]
